1.consolidated_definition: econ. Transnacional, extraterritorial. Empresa, institución o servicios registrados o localizados en un país extranjero generalmente para acogerse a los beneficios relacionados con el pago de impuestos. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Los paraísos offshore son absolutamente legales y por tanto mantienen portales en internet donde ofrecen libremente sus servicios a la clientela. Tecleas “offshore banking” en Google y la tercera entrada es Panama Offshore Legal - Offshore Asset Protection Services (Cáncer capitalista, 03-05-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Económico. Transnational, extraterritorial. A company, institution, or service registered or located in a foreign country generally to take advantage of tax benefits related to payment of taxes. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. Offshore paradises are absolutely legal and therefore maintain internet portals where they freely offer their services to clients. Typing "offshore banking" into Google yields Panama Offshore Legal - Offshore Asset Protection Services (Cancerous capitalism, 03-05-08)

2.consolidated_definition: Se dice de los vientos que soplan de tierra al mar. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. El domingo, antes de comenzar los cuartos de final, las condiciones se tornaron off-shore debido a unas leves lloviznas, mejorando aún más las condiciones en el agua (El Nuevo Día, 02-10-07)
2.en_consolidated_definition: Onshore winds are those that blow from land to sea. A crude Anglicism, infrequently used. On Sunday, before the quarterfinals began, conditions turned off-shore due to light drizzle, further improving water conditions (El Nuevo Día, 02-10-07)

3.en_consolidated_definition: Offshore sports are those nautical sports that take place at sea. Anglicism, often used in its raw form. One of its sons, Richard Henry, is a prominent offshore racing pilot (The New Day, 09-09-05)
